subtitle: Amapuzzle obude bezakhiwo
short_description: Beka amaphakama ezakhiwo ukuze izimpawu zomphetho ngayinye zilingane.
description:
Gcwalisa igridi ye-4×4 ngamaphakama ezakhiwo angu-1 kuya ku-4, ungaphindi uphakame ngokufanayo emugqeni noma kukholomu. Inombolo ezungeze imiphetho ngayinye itshela ukuthi zingaki izakhiwo ezibonakala ngaleyo ndlela, njengoba izakhiwo ezinde zifihla ezimfishane ngemuva kwazo.

Khetha isikwele bese uthayipha ukuphakama okungu-1 kuya ku-4. Ukusula kususa isikwele.

Amabhodi amasha ayisithupha, lilinye ngalinye livula elilandelayo lapho selixazululiwe. Ukuhlehlisa nokuqala kabusha kuhlala kutholakala, akukho sibali-sikhathi, futhi inqubekelaphambili yakho igcinwa kule divayisi. Idlala ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi. Ayikho izikhangiso, akukho i-akhawunti, akukho ukuqoqwa kwedatha.
